name: Champion Kit
tagline: Arm your internal champion to sell for you
about: Champion Kit builds the business case, ROI model, executive one-pager and mutual action plan your internal champion needs to win budget when you're not in the room.
persona: You are a value-engineering consultant: rigorous with numbers, transparent about assumptions, fluent in CFO language; you never inflate ROI.

onboarding.title: Win the meeting you're not in
onboarding.subtitle: Your product's value drivers power every business case.

profile.label: Main value drivers
profile.placeholder: labour savings, fewer picking errors, faster shipping

tools.title: Business case
tools.subtitle: For the budget meeting

inputs.label: Customer situation & numbers
inputs.placeholder: 3 warehouses, 120 pickers at $22/h, 2% error rate, 40k orders/month

tools.prompt: Build a business case for the profile's product at {price} given: {situation}, in the profile's currency. Sections: text executive summary (under 120 words), a table (Value driver | Current cost | With us | Annual impact | Assumption), kv (Total annual benefit | Annual cost | Net benefit | Payback months | 3-year ROI %), a callout listing every assumption to validate, and bullets of the 3 risks a CFO will raise with a one-line answer each.

tools.title: ROI calculator
tools.subtitle: Conservative, base, upside
tools.prompt: Model ROI with annual cost {cost}, estimated annual benefit {benefit} and {ramp} months ramp to full value (assume 6 if blank), in the profile's currency. Sections: a table (Scenario | Year-1 net | Year-3 net | Payback months | ROI %) for Conservative (50% of benefit), Base (100%) and Upside (130%), steps showing how each figure was calculated, a callout on which scenario to present first and why, and a quote with one sentence to say when they challenge the benefit number.

tools.title: Executive one-pager
tools.subtitle: What the sponsor forwards

inputs.label: Executive & their priority
inputs.placeholder: COO, cutting fulfilment cost per order

inputs.label: Proof points
inputs.placeholder: cut cost per order 18% at a similar 3PL

tools.prompt: Write an executive one-pager for {exec} with proof: {proof}, for the profile's product. Sections: a quote with the one-pager text (headline, 3-sentence problem, 3-sentence solution, 3 proof bullets, the ask; under 200 words total), kv (Headline metric | The ask | Decision needed by), and bullets on how the champion should present it in 2 minutes.

tools.title: Mutual action plan
tools.subtitle: Shared close plan with the champion

inputs.label: Known steps
inputs.placeholder: security review, legal redlines, CFO approval, pilot sign-off

tools.prompt: Build a mutual action plan to sign by {target} covering: {steps_known}. Sections: a table (Step | Owner: us/them | Due | Status | Dependency) working backwards from the signature date, a checklist of steps the champion must own, a callout on the step most likely to slip and how to pre-empt it, and a quote with the message that introduces the plan to the champion.

tools.title: Coach the champion
tools.subtitle: Prep them for the internal pitch

inputs.label: Champion & their role
inputs.placeholder: Priya, ops manager, first time sponsoring a purchase

tools.prompt: Coach {champion} to pitch the profile's product internally to {audience}. Sections: steps for a 5-minute internal pitch, a table (Objection they'll hear | What to say | Backup data), bullets of the questions they should ask us before the meeting, and a quote with a confidence-building message to send them the night before.

disclaimer: ROI, cost and forecast figures are illustrative estimates from the numbers you enter, not financial advice; validate every assumption with real data and your finance team.
